# laravelforge_site_heartbeat (Data Source)

Fetches a single heartbeat monitor on a Laravel Forge site by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the heartbeat.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server that owns the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the heartbeat belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `custom_frequency` (String) A cron expression representing the custom frequency, used when `frequency` is -1.
- `frequency` (Number) The interval (in minutes) at which the client is expected to send a ping.
- `grace_period` (Number) The duration (in minutes) after which a heartbeat is considered missing.
- `name` (String) The name of the heartbeat.
- `ping_url` (String) The URL the client pings to report a heartbeat.
- `status` (String) Current heartbeat status (`pending`, `beating`, or `missing`).
